I have final approval on the launch policy, and the current draft enables it for all eligible customers with a 24-hour transition period, no advance customer notice, and 30-day retention of ordinary rotation logs. Before I approve, I need to hear from each of you — backend engineering, customer success, and security — on any operational or customer-facing requirements you see.
